```{r}
library(nnet)
```

```{r}
z <- read.table("/Users/sorenbasnet/Desktop/STAT_443_SP_2026/Data_files_export/fishdata.txt", header=TRUE)

mult.model <- multinom(species ~ . , data=z)
```
```{r}
mult.model
```

```{r}
predicted <- predict(mult.model, newdata=z, type="class")
table(predicted, z$species)
```
